title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
About Tala
 
Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority.  We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on.

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.
 
Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.
 
Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

Our vision is to build a new financial ecosystem where everyone can participate on equal footing and access the tools they need to be financially healthy. We strongly believe that inclusion fosters innovation and we’re proud to have a diverse global team that represents a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and experience. We hire talented people regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
About CoVet

At CoVet , we're building AI-powered tools that help veterinary professionals spend less time on paperwork and more time caring for animals.

Veterinary teams are stretched thin. Long hours, administrative burden, and burnout are challenges across the industry. We're on a mission to change that. Our AI copilot helps veterinary professionals save time, improve workflows, and focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

We're a globally distributed team united by a shared mission to support veterinary professionals through thoughtful technology. We move quickly, collaborate openly, and believe great ideas can come from anyone.

If you're excited by the opportunity to shape the future of veterinary medicine while working alongside an ambitious and supportive team, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

We're looking for a Product Designer, Design Systems & Delivery who's passionate about creating seamless, consistent, and intuitive product experiences.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between design and development, working closely with Product and Engineering to ensure great ideas translate into polished, user-friendly features. From maintaining design consistency to improving the little details that make a big difference, you'll play a key role in shaping the CoVet experience.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a fast-growing company, helping veterinary professionals reclaim valuable time in their day.

Exciting Opportunities in this Role

•
Champion Design Quality: Review UI/UX implementations, identify inconsistencies, and document actionable improvements.

•
Drive Design Consistency: Maintain and evolve our design system, promoting reusable components and cohesive experiences across features.

•
Improve the User Experience: Own small-scale UI enhancements inspired by customer feedback, support tickets, and usability insights.

•
Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with Product and Engineering to solve design challenges, prioritize requests, and keep releases moving.

•
Turn Feedback Into Action: Translate user insights and post-launch feedback into meaningful product improvements.

•
Support Product Delivery: Make thoughtful design decisions quickly while maintaining quality in a fast-paced development environment.

Qualifications

We're more interested in finding the right person than checking every box.

• 3+ years of experience in digital product design, ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or tech environment.

• Strong Figma skills, including components, variants, tokens, and design systems.

• Experience reviewing UI implementations and creating clear, actionable design tickets or bug reports.

• Strong visual and interaction design skills, with attention to responsive behaviour, accessibility, and edge cases.

• Experience collaborating with Product and Engineering through short release cycles.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, make independent decisions, and communicate clearly.

Nice to Have

• Front-end development knowledge (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

• Familiarity with Linear, Amplitude, or similar tools.

• Experience with QA processes and product testing.

• Experience using AI tools to streamline design workflows.

• Spanish language proficiency.

About You

You'll thrive in this role if you:

•
Have an eye for detail: You spot the little inconsistencies others might miss and love making things better.

•
Take ownership: You're proactive, resourceful, and follow through from identifying a problem to delivering a solution.

•
Move fast and adapt: You're comfortable with shifting priorities, quick decisions, and short release cycles.

•
Love consistency: You believe great design is intuitive, scalable, and built on thoughtful patterns.

•
Are a team player: You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and enjoy solving problems together.

•
Put users first: You're motivated by creating experiences that make people's lives easier, one improvement at a time

title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Winter 2027)
description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

• Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)

title: Product Designer
description:
ABOUT US

We’re building the next generation of the TV operating system, reimagining the experience at the intersection of television, streaming, and how people discover and search.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Designer who thinks in systems, questions assumptions, and can solve problems that don’t have an established answer.

This is a hands-on role spanning product thinking, interaction design, and visual design. You’ll help define the structure and behavior of our TV operating system, where AI is woven throughout the experience, taking ideas from early concepts and user flows through prototypes, polished interfaces, and implementation.

You should be as comfortable thinking about the big picture as you are getting deep into the details. One day, you might define how a new product experience should work; the next, you might prototype an interaction, refine elements of our design system, or test a concept with users.

You’ll report to our Head of Design and collaborate closely with the founder, engineers, and marketing team. Beyond making excellent work, you’ll help define what great design looks like and contribute to a culture where design is central to how we build.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own product design from early exploration and user flows through interaction design, prototyping, final UI, and implementation support

- Help define the right problems to solve, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints

- Shape core experiences across our TV operating system

- Design for the realities of TV, with clear hierarchy, readable interfaces, and thoughtful voice first remote navigation and focus states

- Build interactive prototypes to explore product behavior, communicate ideas, and test assumptions before development

- Use research, usability testing, product data, and feedback to inform decisions and improve experiences

- Evolve our design system, creating reusable components and patterns that help the team move quickly without lowering the bar

- Partner closely with engineers throughout development, working through edge cases and ensuring the shipped experience reflects the design intent

- Help shape our emerging design culture, standards, and creative point of view

YOU

- 5+ years of experience

- Have a portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, visual craft, and thoughtful interaction design

- Have experience designing and shipping products, at a startup, agency, or similarly fast-moving environment

- Can turn complex or loosely defined problems into clear, intuitive experiences

- Have a strong command of typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Think beyond individual screens to consider complete journeys, interaction patterns, accessibility, and edge cases

- Are proficient in Figma and comfortable working with tokens, components, design systems

- Have strong instincts but welcome feedback, evidence, and better ideas

- Are autonomous and comfortable making progress when the path is not fully defined

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience designing for TV, streaming, connected devices, or remote-based interfaces

- Experience designing conversational, voice-driven, or AI-powered product experiences

- Strong motion design skills and an understanding of how animation can clarify product behavior and create delight

- Experience building a product or design system from an early stage

- Familiarity with front-end development or code-based prototyping

- An interest in exploring new creative tools and workflows, including AI, while maintaining a high standard of original craft

title: Federal Compliance Lead
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is looking for a Federal Compliance Lead to build and run our federal compliance program from the ground up. As we grow across civilian, defense, and intelligence agencies, you will make sure every government deal meets federal acquisition, security, and ethics requirements while keeping deals moving. You will partner closely with our Federal sales team, Deal Desk, Legal, Engineering, and Security, and you will own the policies, processes, and guidance that let Factory sell to the U.S. government with confidence.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

- Build Factory’s Federal Compliance Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain Factory’s public sector sales compliance program from the ground up, establishing policies, standard operating procedures, and monitoring mechanisms for government deals.

- Accelerate Factory’s Federal Transactions: Partner directly with Federal Account Executives and Deal Desk from opportunity qualification through award. Review RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs for compliance obligations, flow-down clauses, commercial item determinations (FAR Part 12), and contractual risk.

- Enforce Statutory and Regulatory Standards: Ensure comprehensive compliance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Procurement Integrity Act, Trade Agreements Act (TAA), Buy American Act, and NDAA Section 889.

- Bridge Product, Security, and Public Sector Standards: Partner closely with Engineering and Security to align Factory’s product roadmap with federal certifications and authorization requirements, including ITAR, FIPS, SOC FedRAMP, DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG / IL levels), and NIST SP 800-53 / 800-171 controls.

- Govern Ethics and Integrity Programs: Administer company-wide federal ethics guidelines, managing organizational conflicts of interest (OCI), post-government employment restrictions, anti-kickback policies, and gift/entertainment rules for public sector interactions.

- Monitor Emerging Federal AI Policy: Track federal AI governance directives (including OMB memos and agency-specific AI acquisition guidelines) and Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management (C-SCRM) mandates, translating evolving policy into actionable operational guidance.

description:
Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum der Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Wir sehen die tiefgreifenden Auswirkungen, die unsere Graphen-Lösungen auf die Umgestaltung der Branche habenwerden. Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Die Vision lautet: Beweise allen, dass du etwas grundlegend verändern kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, wie Dinge anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern.

Unsere Technologie

Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung.

Kurz gesagt, wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden so die Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie mittels Graphen.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Du stellst die Versorgungssicherheit sicher, optimierst die Gesamtkosten über den gesamten Beschaffungslebenszyklus hinweg und gewährleistest die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl die sich stets weiterentwickelnden technologischen Anforderungen als auch die Veränderungen der Marktbedingungen.

Deine Aufgaben

- Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, globale Beschaffungsstrategien für Halbleitermaterialien wie Wafer, Fotolacke, CMP-Suspensionen, Spezialgase oder Chemikalien zu entwickeln und zu implementieren.

- Du identifizierst, qualifizierst und steuerst strategisch wichtige Lieferanten und stellst dabei sicher, dass sie optimal auf unsere Technologie-Roadmaps, Qualitätsstandards und Produktionsanforderungen abgestimmt sind.

- Beim Verhandeln von Verträgen, Preisen und sonstigen Konditionen hast du unsere Kostenziele immer im Blick und sicherst gleichzeitig eine verlässliche Belieferung.

- Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln.

- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams aus R&D, Process Engineering, Qualitätssicherung und Fertigung stimmst du die Materialbeschaffung bestmöglich auf die technologischen Vorgaben und Produktionsanforderungen ab.

- Du steuerst die Performance, pflegst die Lieferantenbeziehungen und kümmerst dich um das Reporting in Bezug auf unsere Unternehmensziele.

title: Senior Content Writer, B2B and Technical
description:

About Big Human

Big Human is a full-service digital product agency in New York City. Since 2010 we’ve built 262 websites, 80 applications and 50 brands, and our work has been recognized by TIME, the Webby Awards, the Shorty Awards and Digiday. Our marketing team runs strategy, content, SEO/AEO and paid media for our clients and for Big Human itself.
The role
We’re hiring a senior writer to produce website and marketing content for our clients, with a focus on complex B2B and enterprise technology. This means product pages, solution pages, industry pages and educational content for companies whose buyers range from the people using the software every day to the executives signing off on it.
We use Claude for a lot of the heavy lifting in content production. You’ll use it to get to a strong first draft fast, then do the work that makes the content good: checking every claim, sharpening the language, protecting what the page needs to rank, and making sure the reader feels understood instead of talked at.

This is a part-time role for 10-20 hours/week. Our ideal candidate has working hours between 10 am and 6 pm EST Monday-Friday.
What you’ll do

• Write and edit high volumes of website content across reusable page templates, working in sprints with clear weekly deliverables

• Use Claude and our established content workflows to produce first drafts, then edit them into publishable copy

• Turn technical products into plain language that a buyer can understand, without losing accuracy

• Tailor messaging by audience: company size (enterprise, mid-market, small business) and buyer role (daily user, budget owner, executive)

• Fact-check product and capability claims against source material and subject-matter experts, and flag anything that can’t be verified

• Optimize content for search and AI answer engines using Clearscope, keyword targets and AEO structure (direct answers, FAQs, scannable formatting)

• Work with client product marketers and other subject-matter experts, merge their feedback into our structure, and make the case for what should stay and why

• Present editorial decisions, explaining what changed and why it’s better

• Partner with designers by delivering headlines and structure early so design and content move in parallel

What you bring

• 5+ years of B2B content writing, ideally for enterprise software, SaaS or another technical category

• Strong editing instincts. You can tell when a confident draft is wrong, vague or generic, and you know how to fix it

• Experience writing with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your production process, and a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t

• Working knowledge of SEO and AEO: keyword targeting, search intent and structuring content for both people and AI search

• Comfort learning a complex product or industry quickly, through documentation, demos and interviews

• The confidence to push back on a client rewrite, and the judgment to know when to give ground

• Plain, direct writing. No jargon, no filler, no agency-speak

• Experience managing multiple projects and hitting deadlines on a sprint schedule

Nice to have

Data-Powered Web Applications

About the Role

We're hiring a full stack engineer to build data powered web applications on top of our CX and marketing data stack. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, application development, and analytics. You'll own features end to end, from piping raw event data into our warehouse to shipping polished, AI-driven user-facing products.

If you love writing SQL as much as you love writing React, and you're excited by the idea of turning messy behavioral and marketing data into tools people actually use, this is for you.

You'll build and ship full stack applications in React and Next.js deployed on Vercel, backed by Snowflake and supporting data infrastructure. Dashboarding work in Omni is also part of the mix, both building dashboards directly and building web experiences that embed or extend them.

• Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, and SQL . You can move fluidly between frontend components, API routes, and warehouse queries.

• Ability to design and build dashboards and data visualizations , ideally in Omni (or tools like Looker, Hex, Mode).

• A track record of shipping production web applications, not just prototypes.

Nice to Haves

• Experience integrating LLMs or agentic AI into production apps (OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, RAG, tool use, embeddings, vector search).

• Experience with marketing platforms such as Klaviyo .

About Here Now Health :
Here Now Health is the first virtual healthcare company specifically built for children and families impacted by the child welfare system. We deliver child welfare-informed, high-touch care to Medicaid-covered youth navigating foster care, adoption, kinship placements, and juvenile justice. Our model prioritizes consistency, trust, and accessibility in systems where they are too often missing.
Role Summary
You will be one of the first prescribers in a new psychiatry service designed specifically for youth in and around foster care. You will have direct collaboration with a child and adolescent psychiatrist, a therapy team trained in evidence based psychotherapy , and real influence over how the service works. Psychiatry launches in Virginia in early 2027 and will expand to other HNH states.
Key Responsibilities
Clinical care

• Conduct 60-minute initial psychiatric evaluations and 30-minute medication management follow-ups by video.

• Build treatment plans that pair medication with the evidence-based therapy each patient receives from their HNH therapist.

• Prescribe and monitor psychotropic medications under HNH protocols, including baseline and follow-up labs, metabolic monitoring, and AIMS for antipsychotics.

• Review and simplify complex medication regimens, which many of our patients arrive with after multiple placements and prescribers.

• Prescribe electronically, including controlled substances through EPCS where permitted, and check state PDMPs as required.

• Practice measurement-based care using serial screening instruments, and adjust treatment based on the data.

• Assess risk at every visit and follow HNH safety protocols, escalating to the Lead Psychiatrist or emergency services when a patient needs a higher level of care.

Working within the child welfare system

• Obtain informed consent for psychotropic medication from whoever holds legal authority (agency, court, or parent, depending on state and custody status) and obtain the youth’s assent.

• Work within each state’s psychotropic medication oversight requirements for youth in foster care, including documentation and review processes.

• Communicate with foster, kinship, and adoptive caregivers, caseworkers, and other members of the child’s team, within the limits of consent and privacy law.

• Give caregivers clear, practical guidance on diagnoses, medications, side effects, and warning signs.

• Protect continuity of care through placement changes, including medication reconciliation and timely records transfer.

Team and program building

• Coordinate closely with each patient’s therapist and attend weekly interdisciplinary team meetings.

• Complete documentation within 24 hours, with accurate coding.

• Help build a new service by giving feedback on workflows, templates, and protocols, and taking part in quality improvement and peer review.

Who You’ll Care For
Children ages 6 and older, adolescents, and young adults through age 26 who have been in foster care. Most have histories of complex trauma and multiple placements.Patients who need a higher level of care are referred out and may return after stabilization.

• Supervision. You report to the Founding Lead Psychiatrist, a board-certified child, adolescent, and adult psychiatrist, who provides (weekly case review and on-call consultation) and collaborative practice oversight where state law requires it.

• Visit cadence. Psychiatry follow-up frequency is set by clinical need and can differ from therapy cadence.

• Training. All HNH clinicians are trained in engaging youth with complex trauma histories and in our measurement-based care framework.

title: Associate - Tax
description:
About Norm Ai
Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management.

Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world.

Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products.

AI Fluency:
Norm Ai prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end.

Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity.

THIS ROLE

As a Tax Associate at Norm Law, you will support a 360-degree funds tax practice representing marquee managers across private equity, venture, credit, hedge, and other private investment fund matters. You'll work on entity structuring, fund formation, manager advisory, and portfolio transactions. You will interact, train and be assisted by AI agents who will help you be more efficient, specifically through pattern recognition across voluminous documents. You will continue to enjoy the usual aspects of tax law practice in terms of technical accuracy, research and exercising and developing judgment on tax issues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Document Drafting & Review: Leverage AI agents to do an initial pass of reviewing fund formation documents such as LPAs, subscription agreements and side letters.

- Due Diligence: Use AI tools to conduct rapid document reviews, identify key terms and tax provisions.

- Fund Structuring & Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management across the full fund lifecycle to the extent feasible.

- Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the fund tax practice even more efficient using AI.

- Traditional Tax Structuring, Research and Advisory: You will continue to do the tax structuring, relevant research and advisory that you would do in a law firm, with the level of technical accuracy and excellence expected at any BigLaw firm.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

CORE QUALIFICATIONS

- Juris Doctor (JD); active bar admission in New York.

- 3-6 years of tax experience at a top law firm, with meaningful exposure to private investment funds (private equity, venture, credit and/or hedge).

- Strong technical foundation in Subchapters K and C; familiarity with UBTI, ECI, and fund structuring for diverse investor bases. Knowledge of Subchapter S and real estate tax planning a plus.

- High Interest in building AI-assisted workflows.

- High Interest in building a new law firm model, a great “roll-up the sleeves” attitude, agility in performing simple tasks to doing the hard core research on tough tax issues and not expecting AI to replace a lawyer’s judgment.

- High comfort with ambiguity, a necessary attribute when helping build a truly new law firm model powered by revolutionary technology

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms and tech teams supporting such platforms; Integrate with existing tax team and fund working groups on live deals; Assist in maintaining tax intake risk management for the firm.

- 60 Days: Master work flow integration with existing tax team and funds group. Independently manage discrete components of live matters.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
description:
We're Sharp Performance

Sharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.

We help first responders and their spouses thrive through confidential coaching from people with similar lived experience. Our coaches have carried the badge, worn the gear, or stood beside someone who did. Through our mobile platform, we connect law enforcement, firefighters, and other frontline professionals with coaches who understand the job because they have lived it.

We're early-stage and backed by amazing investors. The team is small enough that your work shows up in the rollout, the product, and the customer's experience within weeks. If building something that matters alongside people who hold a high standard sounds better than a safe seat somewhere else, come build it with us.

About the role

Sharp Performance runs a 1-1 coaching marketplace. The C-Squad owns the core platform behind it: the backend, data model, and integrations that coaches, managers, and every other squad build on. That platform got us here. Now it needs to scale to support more users and functionality without slowing the teams that depend on it.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to co-own that problem. You'll help set the technical direction for the platform, write a real share of the code, and raise the bar for how the squad designs, ships, and runs software. This is a senior IC role with team-level leverage, not a people-management track.

How we build

We're all in on agentic engineering. Every squad runs AI agents across the SDLC: implementation, code review, testing, incident triage, and maintenance. We treat agents as participants in delivery, not chat assistants. That means a disciplined harness around them: tight scope, specialized agents, verification, and human approval before anything ships. Right now we're giving agents controlled access to production evidence (code, logs, database state) so they can test hypotheses and validate fixes themselves.

That changes what platform work means here. Our systems serve customers and the agents building on them. Clean interfaces, fast feedback loops, good observability, and safe guardrails make both humans and agents faster.

What you'll do

• Co-own the architecture and long-term health of our core platform: a Laravel monolith with its database, API, background jobs, and internal admin tooling.

• Build platform foundations other squads rely on: stable APIs and contracts, CI/CD, environments, feature flags, observability, and on-call readiness.

• Lead scaling work end to end. Find the bottlenecks in the database, queues, caching, and third-party integrations, then fix them before customers feel them.

• Decide where the monolith should stay a monolith and where a service, queue, or event boundary actually pays off. Write the doc, make the call, and land the migration safely.

• Make the platform agent-ready: well-bounded modules, fast CI, reliable test environments, and safe, auditable access for agents to the evidence they need.

• Harden reliability and security as we grow: multi-tenant data isolation, access controls, audit trails, and incident response that holds up to SOC 2.

• Collaborate with C-Squad engineers. Review designs and code, mentor, unblock, and keep the squad's output coherent.

• Work with product and the other squads on roadmap trade-offs, especially when platform work competes with feature work.

What we're looking for

• 8+ years building and running production backend systems, with recent time at staff or lead level.

• A product mindset. You care as much about what we build as how we build it. You ask “why” early, push back when something doesn’t serve users, and work with product and design to shape the roadmap, not just execute it.

• Deep platform engineering experience: you've owned the infrastructure, deploy pipeline, and runtime of a growing product, not just features on top of it.

title: Administrateur(trice) réseau

Eh bien… tu pourrais être exactement à la bonne place! On cherche une personne pour le rôle d'administrateur(trice) réseau afin de joindre notre équipe des opérations réseau à Montréal, Québec. Dans ce rôle, tu contribueras à assurer la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité du réseau d'entreprise interne de Lightspeed à travers nos bureaux mondiaux. Ce poste soutient la connectivité de l'équipe et des bureaux de Lightspeed - et non les réseaux exploités par notre clientèle marchande. Tu auras la responsabilité de gérer et d'optimiser notre connectivité LAN/WAN, l'infrastructure Fortinet, le Wi-Fi d'entreprise, les VPN de site à site, les services de fournisseurs d'accès Internet (FAI) et les environnements physiques du réseau. - Maintenir et optimiser l'infrastructure LAN/WAN d'entreprise, le routage, la commutation, les pare-feux, le SD-WAN, les réseaux sans fil, les VPN, les VLAN, DHCP/DNS et la connectivité FAI à travers nos bureaux mondiaux.

- Agir comme point d'escalade de niveaux 2 et 3 pour les problèmes réseau complexes, piloter le triage des incidents, l'analyse des causes fondamentales et la mise en place de mesures correctives à long terme.

- Soutenir les initiatives de fiabilité du réseau, notamment la connectivité redondante, le basculement double FAI, la résilience des VPN et la gestion réseau centralisée.

- Réaliser les changements et les mises à niveau du réseau en respectant les processus établis de gestion du changement, incluant les tests, les fenêtres de maintenance, la validation et la planification de retour en arrière. Automatisation propulsée par l'IA et opérations proactives

- Collaborer avec les équipes réseau mondiales pour cerner et déployer des solutions d'automatisation et d'IA permettant d'améliorer les opérations réseau, la fiabilité et l'efficacité.

- Tirer profit de la télémétrie réseau, des plateformes de surveillance (dont PRTG) et des outils de gestion Fortinet pour améliorer la détection des anomalies, les alertes intelligentes et la résolution proactive des problèmes.

- Concevoir, déployer et optimiser l'infrastructure Wi-Fi 6/6E d'entreprise dans nos bureaux mondiaux, incluant les relevés RF, la cartographie thermique, la planification de capacité et l'optimisation du rendement.

- Dépanner et optimiser la connectivité sans fil, l'itinérance et l'authentification par certificat (802.1X) pour assurer un accès réseau fiable et hautement performant.

- Piloter le déploiement de l'infrastructure réseau en Amérique du Nord et dans la région APAC pour les déménagements de bureaux, les agrandissements et les projets de renouvellement, incluant l'approvisionneme

The Executive Lead for Global SMB Engineering is the senior technology executive for Global Payments ' SMB business worldwide. The role reports to the Global CTO, sits on the CTO's leadership team and is the engineering counterpart to the President of SMB. It carries full accountability for technology strategy, engineering delivery and platform health across a global organization of around 3,500 people.

This role sets the leadership direction for SMB engineering and owns the platforms behind our SMB products, which serve over 6 million merchants.
The role has two priorities: keep delivering the products merchants rely on today, and modernize the platforms behind them for the next decade.

Modernization includes standardizing and simplifying our product estate to remove duplication. It also means moving to API first, cloud native, event driven architecture, setting one standard for how software is built, tested and operated across SMB, and making a step change in developer productivity.

The role partners closely with Product leadership and the business to decide what we build, what we buy, and which technology partners we work with. It leads engineering delivery against those plans and is measured on results against growth, reliability and security targets.

What you'll own

• SMB engineering strategy, with every major investment tied to growth, reliability or security outcomes.

• A global engineering organization of around 3,500 people, including its operating model and the strength of its leadership team.

• Standardizing and simplifying the SMB product estate, and moving it to API first, cloud native, event driven design.

• One standard for SDLC, testing and SRE practice across every SMB team, with developer productivity measured and improved.

• Build or buy decisions, made together with Product leadership and the business, plus governance and performance management of strategic technology vendors.

• Joint delivery with Product, Operations, Finance and Sales so that engineering work shows up in commercial results.

• A clear point of view on unified commerce, embedded payments and AI in risk and operations, built into the roadmap.

• Hiring, developing and keeping strong engineering leaders, with successors in place for senior roles.

• Representing SMB engineering to the CTO, the President of SMB and the Senior Leadership Team.

What you bring:

• You've led engineering at global scale on large, customer-facing platforms, at or close to the top technology seat.

• You've led large engineering organizations and set their vision, plan and roadmap.

What sets you apart

• You've led engineering through an acquisition, from diligence to post-merger integration.

• You've applied AI and machine learning to fraud and risk, routing or developer productivity.

• You've scaled a platform used by millions of small businesses.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration.

Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs.

You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs.

- Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration.

- Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes.

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets.

• Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus.

• Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context.

Who we are looking for

• Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English.

• Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language

• Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role.

• Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail.

Project at a glance

• Project duration: one week since the mid of November

• Languages: Japanese

• Project time commitment: 6 hours per person

• Project compensation: US$75 - US$90 per hour

• Work location: fully remote in Japan

How selection works (major steps)

• Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability.

• Language test: short exercises in the target language.

• Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track.

• Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role.

• Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

title: Head of Investor Relations
description:
Rohlik is three stories in one: the leading online grocer in Central Europe with more than €1 billion in revenue, a fast-growing business in Germany, and Veloq, the technology platform that runs our operations and that we now sell to other grocers. Investors will want to know how these fit together, what each is worth and whether management delivers what it says. Your job is to make the answers clear, consistent and backed by numbers, long before any listing.

Rohlik is entering a new stage of its growth, and we are building a dedicated Investor Relations function for the first time. We are looking for a Head of Investor Relations who will build IR from the ground up, prepare Rohlik for the requirements of the public markets and, in the future, run Investor Relations for a listed company.

You will report to the Group CFO. Finance owns the numbers. You will own how those numbers become a credible, consistent story for investors - and challenge that story before anyone outside the company does.

This is a senior, highly visible Individual Contributor role, supported by FP&A, Financial Reporting and the wider Finance organisation.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Build IR from zero. You will shape the function, processes and investor approach from the beginning.

- Shape the equity story. You will influence the narrative, KPIs and financial story before they become established market expectations.

- Partner directly with the Group CFO on investor communication, strategic messaging and capital-markets topics.

- A rare listing. Few tech-led companies from Central Europe have gone to public markets. You would take one there.

- Build long-term investor relationships across Europe and the US while creating an AI-enabled IR setup from day one.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Build and continuously sharpen Rohlik’s equity story, connecting the narrative to a clear and consistent set of KPIs

- Own communication with existing shareholders, prospective investors and bondholders

- Build relationships with investors and analysts and become the primary point of contact for performance, modelling and the long-term investment story

- Partner with FP&A and Financial Reporting to ensure one consistent set of numbers across investor, Board and external materials

- Develop the KPI and guidance framework and lead investor education through roadshows, conferences and one-to-one meetings

- Lead the IR workstream for any future IPO, including analyst presentations, prospectus content, roadshow materials and investor Q&A

- Establish the processes required for life as a listed company, including results communication, sell-side coverage, investor calendar and disclosure requirements

- Build an AI-enabled IR infrastructure, including investor CRM, Q&A libraries and automated KPI and reporting packs

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of relevant experience across Investor Relations, equity research, Equity Capital Markets or a comparable capital-markets environment

- Ideally, experience taking at least one company through an IPO from the issuer side

- Strong relationships with institutional investors, ideally across Europe and the US

- Deep financial understanding - you can challenge IFRS financial statements, financial models, unit economics and key operating metrics

- Strong understanding of public-company disclosure requirements, including MAR, inside information and quiet periods

- Executive presence and confidence representing the company independently in front of investors and analysts

- Strong judgement, independence and willingness to challenge the narrative when the numbers do not support it

- Hands-on use of AI and modern tools

- Fluent English

- Based in Prague, with regular travel to London, Frankfurt, New York and other financial centres

- Experience from consumer, retail, e-commerce or technology would be particularly relevant.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

- Fair reward - You’ll get a strong fixed salary - no bonus games, no p
